review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines flipAt (Function.update b i (!b i)), crossRidge (a Finset.erase of crossFacet), and several lemmas. The definitions are thin wrappers over existing Mathlib operations (Function.update, Finset.erase). They are named, specialised, and used in the lemmas. A Mathlib grep for the update-with-negation pattern found no competing Mathlib concept. The chain and boundary definitions (F2.lean, Coefficients.lean) are not in this file, so I did not assess them. I found no independent duplicate of a Mathlib concept in this file. The only remaining uncertainty is whether the wider Borsuk development duplicates Mathlib's simplicial complexes. That is outside this file.
